sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend; copper and gold provide partial offset. WA gold juniors active. Austal M&A positive.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from weak iron ore. Gold names (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and copper (CPL.AX) offer relative strength. Austal (AUS.AX) bid creates short-term upside.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall on rate-hike fears and credit-cycle deterioration. Qantas $35M payout signals corporate stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX pressured by rising NIM expectations offset by credit-risk concerns. REITs vulnerable to higher rates.

sectors.trend: Brent >$100 on Middle East conflict benefits oil producers; Santos gas dynamics shifting; data-centre power demand surging.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SAI.AX benefit from oil spike. Santos (STO.AX) faces cartel-break dynamics. Data-centre power demand supports AGL.AX, CGP.AX, INC.AX.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic; home sentiment collapse; Nike/Lululemon weakness signals global consumer softness.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, CSL.AX face demand headwinds. CSL.AX (CSL.AX) remains defensive anchor. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: AI data-centre buildout at coal sites; Australia's construction capacity constrained; ATO vs Big Tech tax fight.
sectors.implications: Data-centre REITs and power infrastructure names benefit. Construction capacity limits capex cycle. Tech tax risk for ASX-listed platforms.

key_themes: Oil spike >$100 driving inflation re-acceleration and RBA hawkish repricing
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 200 top-weight names
RBA 'recession choice' — tightening into a slowing economy
Housing downturn: buyer sentiment collapse, NZ crash spillover risk
WA gold exploration boom providing sector rotation opportunity
China-US trade escalation threatening commodity demand
Energy transition vs data-centre power demand creating infrastructure tailwinds
Corporate stress signals: Qantas payouts, mall closures, business conditions at pandemic lows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation re-acceleration forcing further RBA hikes
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate sensitivity via short-duration bonds; favour fixed-income over equities; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse from China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold and copper; monitor China PMI and steel output

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing credit cycle deterioration and recession
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX); favour defensive healthcare (CSL.AX) and staples (WES.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China-US trade escalation disrupting commodity flows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from China-exposed miners; monitor tariff announcements and shipping data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW/national power supply constraints limiting economic growth
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AEMO data; favour power generators and grid infrastructure names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold juniors and mid-tiers on exploration momentum
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits and shovel-ready projects; gold benefits from geopolitical risk and rate uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Add oil & gas producers on Brent >$100
opportunities.rationale: Middle East conflict sustains elevated crude; WDS and WLE benefit directly from price spike

opportunities.recommendation: Position in power/infrastructure names for data-centre demand
opportunities.rationale: AI data centres at coal sites create multi-year capex cycle; NSW power constraints support generators

opportunities.recommendation: Austal takeover bid — trade the M&A premium
opportunities.rationale: $1.9b bid creates immediate upside; monitor deal certainty and regulatory approval

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore exposure; rotate to gold/copper
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'drowning' structurally; China demand weak; gold offers inflation and geopolitical hedge

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight banks and REITs ahead of potential RBA hike
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate-hike bets pressure valuations; credit cycle deteriorating; home sentiment at milestone lows

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Recession risk elevated; business conditions at pandemic lows; 'war on equities' narrative

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to test lower supports as oil-driven inflation fears and RBA hawkish repricing dominate. Iron ore weakness drags materials. Expect volatility around Middle East headlines. Banks and REITs under pressure. Gold and energy provide relative outperformance.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural iron ore decline and China demand softness cap mining multiples. Housing downturn and business conditions at pandemic lows suggest 6-12 month earnings revision risk. Data-centre power demand and WA gold exploration offer structural growth pockets. RBA policy normalisation may stabilise by H2 2026.

Brent crude trajectory — sustained >$100 or pullback
China PMI and iron ore demand data

Chinese steel output and property data
Qantas and airline sector cost pressures
